title: AgentArtifactRef
description: Pointer from an AgentMessage to a concrete piece of evidence on disk or in another structured stream. Always a reference, never an inlined blob. Used for screenshots in <job>/results/, log slices in logs/cli-output.log, supervisor advisories in logs/meta/<project>/observations.jsonl, product runtime events, status.md projections, and external diagnostics endpoints. The bus stays small; the artifact is fetched on demand by the UI projection.

kind.description: What flavour of artifact this reference points at. Drives how the UI renders the link (image preview, log range, markdown render, raw JSON viewer).

uri.description: Reference path. Prefer workspace-relative POSIX paths for on-disk artifacts (results/playwright/foo.png, logs/cli-output.log, logs/meta/<project>/observations.jsonl). Use file: for absolute filesystem paths and https: only for external integrations. The reader resolves these against the project root or workspace root depending on the artifact kind.

label.description: Short human-readable label rendered next to the link, e.g. 'Run 3 screenshot', 'observations.jsonl line 42'. Optional; the UI falls back to the basename of the uri.

byteRange.description: Optional byte slice for log-slice artifacts. Lets the timeline link to the exact span of CLI output the message refers to without copying the bytes onto the bus.

start.description: Inclusive byte offset within the referenced file.

end.description: Exclusive byte offset within the referenced file.

lineRange.description: Optional 1-based line slice for log-slice and markdown artifacts when line numbers are more meaningful than bytes.

sha256.description: Optional content hash, lower-case hex. Helps the system-review monitor confirm an artifact has not been overwritten by a later run before citing it.

bytes.description: Optional artifact size in bytes at write time. Helps the UI decide whether to inline-render or lazy-fetch.
